units.source_text: 千重子好容易才下楼来，父亲已经出门，不在家了。

en.t: Chieko finally managed to come downstairs, but her father had already gone out and was no longer at home.

units.source_text: 她在内客厅里把炭火拨弄好，看了看周围，又望了望窄小的庭院。

en.t: In the inner sitting room, she tended the charcoal fire, looked around, and then gazed out at the narrow little garden.

units.source_text: 那棵老枫树上长着的苔藓，依然是绿油油的，

en.t: The moss growing on the old maple tree was still lush and green,

units.source_text: 而寄生在树干上的那两株紫花地丁的叶子，却已经开始枯黄了。

en.t: but the leaves of the two violet plants clinging to the trunk had already begun to wither and turn yellow.
